metadata.title: Audio→Text — Turn audio into accurate text in seconds
metadata.description: Upload a recording and get a clean, accurate transcript powered by OpenAI Whisper. Free plan with {minutes} minutes of audio every month — no credit card required.

hero.subtitle: Drop in a recording — a meeting, a lecture, a voice note — and get a clean transcript powered by OpenAI Whisper. No installs, no manual typing, no waiting around.
hero.freeNote: Free plan includes {minutes} minutes of audio every month. No credit card required.
hero.imageAlt: Abstract sound waveform resolving into clean lines, representing audio becoming text

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.step1Body: Drag & drop any common format — mp3, wav, m4a, flac, ogg and more. Files up to 25 MB.
howItWorks.step2Body: State-of-the-art speech recognition handles accents, background noise, and dozens of languages.
howItWorks.step3Body: Your transcript is ready in seconds. Copy it to the clipboard or download it as a .txt file.

features.heading: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.
features.f1Body: The same model trusted across the industry for near-human transcription accuracy.
features.f2Body: Whisper was trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual audio. Speak how you speak.
features.f3Body: A clear monthly minute counter — see exactly what you have used and what is left.
features.f4Body: Every transcription is saved to your private history, searchable whenever you need it.
features.f5Body: One-click copy to clipboard, or download transcripts as plain .txt files.
features.f6Body: Your files are processed for transcription only — never used to train models.

pricing.heading: Simple, honest pricing
pricing.subheading: No tiers, no credit card, no surprises.
pricing.feature2: All supported formats, files up to 25 MB

finalCta.heading: Stop typing what you already said.
finalCta.subtitle: Your first {minutes} minutes are free every month — upload a file and see the transcript for yourself.
